theorem: For every open one-step source sector the two active precollapse channel coefficients have magnitudes strictly between 0 and 1. Therefore an adjacent integer completion can only use magnitudes 0 or 1 in the auxiliary chart. The outward coherent completion is the actual_upper_sextet_aux. No component of magnitude 2 can occur, so the user-specified M_UP is not reached, not an isolated tie, and has empty source fiber.

exposure.actual_upper_sextet: one member per open sector; positive source arc measure; under uniform source angle each member has probability 1/6 if the UP policy is applied
exposure.mandatory_user_M_UP: empty fiber; probability 0 under every source measure because no source orientation admits it as an adjacent one-step completion

D6: Both sextets are D6 orbits under R6(u,v,w)=(-w,-u,-v), but only the actual_upper sextet lies in the adjacent integer completion box of a one-step sweep.
